desc:
⚡ POWER CLASH ⚡

Free-for-all superhero fighting in a city you can destroy.

🎲 Roll your first power.
🌀 Step through the portal.
👊 Fight everyone. No teams, no rounds.

💥 Every hit you land earns Hits.
🔓 Hits unlock new powers.
🏙️ Buildings break when you throw people into them.
🔥 Knock players down, get knocked down, get back up and hit harder.

15+ powers to unlock: punches, blasts, throws, flight, giant forms, lasers, swings. Every power fights differently.

Pick a power. Fight everyone. Wreck the city.

NOTE FROM THE OWNER: hi guys, i hope you enjoy this game :D 

Joke: What does Peter Parker tell people he does for a living? Web designer.
